sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This sixth application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for grant of bail to applicant in connection with Crime No.238/2021 for the offence punishable under Sections 379, 420, 468, 471 of IPC and Section 51-A of the Disaster Management Act, registered at Police Station Jhansi Road,
District Gwalior.

At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant has drawn attention of this Court to the order dated 01.02.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.3848/2023 whereby the co-accused-Subham Gautam has been granted benefit of bail.

The case of the applicant is identical to the case of co-accused,
therefore, on the ground of parity, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant herein shall be enlarged on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount Smt. Nikky vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48628606/
1 to the satisfaction of the learned trial court.
